probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __with a specific geometric configuration comprising a plurality of closed ribs with open rib sections positioned between pairs of closed ribs, each open rib section including a fore-aft rib with transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure __and bonded thereto__.

2. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner __that are structurally distinct from a central section of the body panel__.

3. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure __that are separated by at least one closed rib__.

4. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure __wherein each aero cover is bonded to the body panel along its entire perimeter__.

5. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib __in a cross-braced configuration__.

6. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib __in a cross-braced configuration__.

7. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.

8. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel __wherein the fasteners are spaced at intervals of no more than 50mm along the perimeter of each aero cover__.

9. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress __that are load-bearing structural elements__.

10. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress __and wherein the open rib structures provide primary structural reinforcement to the buttresses__.

11. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa __and wherein the material is specifically selected to provide enhanced structural rigidity compared to standard polypropylene__.

12. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers __in a single-shot molding process__.

13. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm __and wherein the thickness is uniform across the closed rib sections__.

14. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm __and wherein the aero covers are thinner than the body panel to provide aerodynamic coverage without adding structural mass__.

15. (Currently Amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress __wherein each open rib structure includes a fore-aft rib with transverse ribs in a cross-braced configuration and is positioned between a pair of closed ribs__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure __wherein each aero cover is bonded to the body panel__.

16. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners __wherein the first and second sections are molded separately and then assembled__.

17. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section __and wherein each buttress is an integral structural element of its respective section__.

18. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib __in a cross-braced pattern__.

19. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib __in a cross-braced pattern__.

20. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.
